setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_computed_sales (region int4, price int4, adjustment int4)

INSERT INTO bench_computed_sales SELECT CASE WHEN i%97=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%32 END, CASE WHEN i%11=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%1001-500 END, CASE WHEN i%13=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%101-50 END FROM generate_series(1,1000000) s(i)
accel_query_sql: SELECT region,sum(price*adjustment) revenue,avg(price-adjustment) net, min(price+adjustment) lo,max(price+adjustment) hi,count(*) n FROM bench_computed_sales GROUP BY region
